help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Frequently asked questions and support.
help.q1: How do I book a ride?
help.a1: Choose Bus or Jeepney, select an online driver, pick your boarding and drop-off stops and number of seats, then confirm. Wait for the driver to accept and show your boarding code at pickup.
help.q2: How do I pay for my ride?
help.a2: Pay cash to your driver at the end of your ride. The booking shows your estimated total for all reserved seats.
help.a3: Open your booking and tap Cancel before boarding. Once your driver verifies your boarding code and starts the ride, cancellation is no longer available.
help.a4: Email us at support.sakay@gmail.com or visit our Help Center.
